nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _rOwned: reflection balances for every holder.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _tOwned, declared but unused token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances: ERC20 allowances.
mapping(address=>bool) private _isExcludedFromFee: fee-exempt accounts.
mapping(address=>bool) private bots: blacklisted addresses blocked from transferring.
mapping(address=>uint) private cooldown: last-buy timestamp per buyer.
uint256 private _rTotal: total reflections supply.
uint256 private _tFeeTotal: cumulative collected fees.
uint256 private _feeAddr1: current tax fee percentage.
uint256 private _feeAddr2: current team fee percentage.
address payable private _feeAddrWallet1: first fee receiver.
address payable private _feeAddrWallet2: second fee receiver.
IUniswapV2Router02 private uniswapV2Router: router used for swaps/liquidity.
address private uniswapV2Pair: created JSI/WETH pair.
bool private tradingOpen: trading switch set in openTrading.
bool private inSwap: reentrancy guard flag used by lockTheSwap.
bool private swapEnabled: enables automatic contract-token swaps.
bool private cooldownEnabled: enables per-buyer cooldown checks.
uint256 private _maxTxAmount: max buy amount while cooldown enabled.
address private _owner: privileged owner set in Ownable constructor.
uint256 private constant _tTotal: 1e12*1e9 total token supply.
address private _previousOwner: declared, unused.
JadenSmithInu constructor: sets WETH fee wallets, mints _rTotal to deployer, exempts fee accounts.
transfer(address,uint256) public: forwards _msgSender as sender to _transfer.
transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount): transfers and decreases allowance via SafeMath.sub.
approve(spender,amount) public: sets allowance through _approve.
_transfer: core transfer logic with bot blacklist, cooldown, maxTx and automatic swapToETH + ETH fee payout.
swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps contract tokens for ETH with block.timestamp deadline, guarded by lockTheSwap.
sendETHToFee: splits contract ETH balance and pushes it to the two fee wallets with .transfer.
openTrading onlyOwner: creates pair, adds liquidity from contract balance, enables swapping and cooldown, sets maxTx.
setBots(address[]) onlyOwner: blacklists a list of addresses.
delBot(address) onlyOwner: removes an address from blacklist.
manualswap: anyone may call; requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 then swaps full contract balance.
manualsend: anyone may call; requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 then pushes ETH to fee wallets.
_tokenTransfer: delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard: applies rAmount subtraction/addition, takes team fee and reflects fee.
_takeTeam: mints reflection share for the contract address.
_reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
receive() external payable: accepts ETH from router swaps.
_approve: zero-address checks and allowance write for owner/spender.
tokenFromReflection: converts reflection amount to token amount using current rate.
balanceOf(account): returns tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account]).
owner() public view returns _owner.
renounceOwnership onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0).
setCooldownEnabled(bool) onlyOwner: toggles the buy cooldown.
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender().
_getValues: computes t/r value tuples for a transfer.
_getTValues: computes token fee, team fee and transfer amount.
_getRValues: computes reflection amount/fee/transfer amount from rate.
_getRate: rSupply.div(tSupply).
_getCurrentSupply: returns reflection and token supply.
_msgSender() internal view virtual returns msg.sender.
name() public pure returns the token name.
symbol() public pure returns the token symbol.
decimals() public pure returns 9.
totalSupply() public pure returns _tTotal.
allowance(owner,spender) public view returns stored allowance.
msg.sender: caller identity used for transfers, fee-wallet authorisation and ownership.
block.timestamp: used for buy cooldown and swap/liquidity deadlines.
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external call from swapTokensForEth.
_feeAddrWallet1.transfer(amount.div(2)): fixed-gas ETH push.
_feeAddrWallet2.transfer(amount.div(2)): fixed-gas ETH push.
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance} payable external call in openTrading.
IUniswapV2Factory(...).createPair external call in openTrading.
manualswap/manualsend permission check relies only on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 (no onlyOwner).
address from parameter of _transfer.
address to parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer.
address sender parameter of transferFrom.
address recipient parameter of transferFrom.
address account parameter of balanceOf.
address spender parameter of approve.
uint256 tAmount parameter of _transferStandard.
uint256 rAmount parameter of tokenFromReflection.
address[] memory bots_ parameter of setBots.
address notbot parameter of delBot.
uint256 tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
uint256 amount parameter of sendETHToFee.
address owner parameter of _approve.
uint256 amount parameter of approve.
contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer.
contractETHBalance = address(this).balance in _transfer.
currentRate = _getRate() inside tokenFromReflection.
tTransferAmount returned by _getValues in _transferStandard.
tTeam team-fee amount in _transferStandard.
tFee reflection-fee amount in _transferStandard.
rTransferAmount added to recipient in _transferStandard.
rAmount subtracted from sender in _transferStandard.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address of transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when decreasing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
_msgSender() simply returns msg.sender.
manualswap authorisation depends on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorisation depends on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender().
cooldown[to] is read/updated using block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer invokes _transfer with _msgSender.
transferFrom invokes _transfer.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains values from _getValues.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance before state finalisation.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to fee wallets right after the swap.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet1 via .transfer.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 via .transfer.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
openTrading calls factory().createPair.
openTrading forwards the whole ETH balance into addLiquidityETH.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBots is restricted by onlyOwner.
delBot is restricted by onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
manualswap uses a hardcoded wallet equality check instead of the owner modifier.
manualsend uses a hardcoded wallet equality check instead of the owner modifier.
The external router swap can re-enter the token via malicious pair/token callbacks while inSwap state is being toggled.
ETH .transfer push executes the receiver's fallback which can re-enter state-changing functions.
Second ETH .transfer push may invoke receiver code that re-enters the contract.
_maxTxAmount bounds the buy amount during cooldown-enabled transfers.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown and maxTx branch in _transfer.
cooldown mapping read/write controls per-buyer timing restrictions.
bots mapping decides whether a transfer reverts.
_isExcludedFromFee bypasses cooldown, maxTx and fee conditions.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send ETH path inside _transfer.
inSwap/lockTheSwap guards the automatic swap path but is reset after external calls.
_feeAddr1 tax fee value is reset inside _transfer.
_feeAddr2 team fee value is reset inside _transfer.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the ETH recipient in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the ETH recipient in sendETHToFee.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the token swap.
uniswapV2Router is assigned and used for pair creation and liquidity.
uniswapV2Pair determines buy/sell branches and fee settings in _transfer.
_rTotal is reduced by rFee inside _reflectFee using SafeMath.sub.
_tFeeTotal accumulates tFee using SafeMath.add.
_rOwned balances are debited/credited with SafeMath in _transferStandard.
_approve writes the owner/spender allowance entry.
Parameter from is the debit address in _transfer.
Parameter to is the credit address in _transfer.
Parameter amount is validated and forwarded in _transfer.
Parameter sender flows into _transfer inside transferFrom.
Parameter recipient flows into _transfer inside transferFrom.
Parameter account indexes _rOwned in balanceOf.
Parameter spender is passed to _approve.
Parameter tAmount is priced by _getValues in _transferStandard.
Parameter rAmount is divided by the current rate in tokenFromReflection.
Parameter bots_ entries are written into the bots blacklist.
Parameter notbot is cleared in the bots mapping.
Parameter tokenAmount is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
Parameter amount is split between the two fee wallets.
Parameter owner indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
Parameter amount is the allowance value set by approve.
contractTokenBalance computed in _transfer is passed to swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance is derived from balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
currentRate divides rAmount in tokenFromReflection.
currentRate multiplies tTeam in _takeTeam.
tTransferAmount is emitted and credited in _transferStandard.
tTeam is forwarded to _takeTeam.
tFee is forwarded to _reflectFee.
rTransferAmount is added to recipient reflection balance.
rAmount is subtracted from sender reflection balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only meaningful as the debit address of _transfer.
Parameter to is only meaningful as the credit address of _transfer.
Parameter amount is the transfer quantity consumed by _transfer.
Parameter sender exists solely to feed _transfer from transferFrom.
Parameter recipient exists solely to feed _transfer from transferFrom.
Parameter account is only used to index _rOwned in balanceOf.
Parameter spender is only forwarded to _approve.
Parameter amount is the allowance value set by approve.
Parameter tAmount is priced by _getValues inside _transferStandard.
Parameter rAmount is divided by the rate inside tokenFromReflection.
The bots_ array only exists to populate the bots blacklist in setBots.
Parameter notbot only clears the bots mapping in delBot.
Parameter tokenAmount is the amount routed to the external swap.
Parameter amount is split across the two ETH pushes in sendETHToFee.
Parameter owner only indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
contractTokenBalance is a transient value inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance is a transient value inside _transfer.
currentRate is a transient divisor inside tokenFromReflection.
tTransferAmount is a transient accounting value inside _transferStandard.
tTeam is a transient fee value inside _transferStandard.
tFee is a transient fee value inside _transferStandard.
rTransferAmount is a transient reflection credit inside _transferStandard.
rAmount is a transient reflection debit inside _transferStandard.
